text: うみの　ポケモンは　やっぱり　つりで　とる　しか　ないや

structure.jp: うみの　ポケモンは
つりで　とる　しか　ないや
structure.en: there's nothing for it but to catch them by fishing

patterns.name: 〜しかない
patterns.span: とる　しか　ない
patterns.explanation: A plain verb plus しかない says there is no other choice than doing that. とる　しか　ない = 'the only way is to catch them'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing says that is the way it is done. つりで = 'by fishing'.

patterns.name: 〜や (sentence ending)
patterns.explanation: や at the end is a casual sigh to yourself, like 'oh well'. ないや = 'there's nothing else, I guess'.
